gates.name: Precise theorem-shaped statement

precise_statement.evidence: Candidate states a fixed splitting-type statistic for x^3-2 modulo rational primes and x^3-t over residue fields F_q[t]/P, with classes split, linear+quadratic, and inert.

finite_field_anchor.evidence: F_q[t] side is exact: closed points are monic irreducibles P, and the class is the factorization type of x^3-t over F_q[t]/P for q=2,5 degree ladders.

integer_holdout.evidence: Integer side checks endpoints 1000000, 2000000, 4000000 for factorization type of x^3-2 modulo unramified primes.

controls.evidence: Observed splitting distributions are inside the preregistered Chebotarev multinomial controls; this validates calibration but gives no anomaly to promote.

compression.evidence: Low-parameter statistic: one cubic polynomial on each side, three splitting classes, and fixed Chebotarev expected proportions.

scale_stability.evidence: Scale gate requires complete 1M/2M/4M/8M integer ladder and a control-surviving anomaly. Complete ladder=false; all within controls=true.

novelty_audit.evidence: The observed object is a known Chebotarev calibration domain; no novelty audit has isolated a mechanism beyond classical/effective Chebotarev density.

reproducibility.evidence: JSON/MD/SVG/script artifacts are present and generated by the cubic Chebotarev audit script.

proof_path.evidence: Known Chebotarev explains the class proportions; the audit found no theorem-shaped new residual or proof path beyond calibration.

expert_pack.evidence: No expert-ready breakthrough pack exists because the result is calibration-only and lacks novelty/proof promotion gates.
